newsitem.title: BULGARIA: BULGARIA C.BANK CUTS MAIN INTEREST RATE TO 6.2 PCT.
newsitem.headline: BULGARIA C.BANK CUTS MAIN INTEREST RATE TO 6.2 PCT.

text.p: The Bulgarian National Bank (BNB) said on Thursday it would cut its main interest rate to 6.20 percent monthly from 8.03 percent in line with the falling yield on short-term government securities.
The new interest rate will go in force on Monday, April 28, the BNB said in a statement.
The rate cut reflected the falling yield of one- and four-week discount T-bills auctioned daily by the Finance Ministry since Friday through Thursday, BNB figures showed.
The lower main interest rate was also in line with projected fall in consumer price inflation to four to five percent in April from 12.3 percent in March.
Effective monthly yield on one-week discount T-bills fell to 5.56-6.95 percent this week from 6.50-10.88 percent the week before.
Effective monthly yield on four-week discount T-bills was 5.78-6.85 percent this week.

Under a $657 million funding package with the International Monetary Fund the BNB adjusts the main rate weekly to the weighted average effective monthly yield of short-term government securities auctioned in five successive days by the Finance Ministry. -- Sofia Newsroom, (++359-2) 911 88
